NKJV.1: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
NKJV.2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
NKJV.3: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by the daughter of Shua, the Canaanitess. Er, the firstborn of Judah, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; so He killed him.
NKJV.4: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
NKJV.5: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
NKJV.6: The sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.
NKJV.7: The son of Carmi was Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the accursed thing.
NKJV.9: Also the sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
NKJV.10: Ram begot Amminadab, and Amminadab begot Nahshon, leader of the children of Judah;
NKJV.11: Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz;
NKJV.12: Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;
NKJV.13: Jesse begot Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
NKJV.14: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
NKJV.15: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh.
NKJV.16: Now their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel—three.
NKJV.17: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
NKJV.18: Caleb the son of Hezron had children by Azubah, his wife, and by Jerioth. Now these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
NKJV.19: When Azubah died, Caleb took Ephrath as his wife, who bore him Hur.
NKJV.20: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezalel.
NKJV.21: Now afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
NKJV.22: Segub begot Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
NKJV.23: (Geshur and Syria took from them the towns of Jair, with Kenath and its towns—sixty towns.) All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
NKJV.24: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Hezron’s wife Abijah bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
NKJV.25: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram, the firstborn, and Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
NKJV.26: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
NKJV.27: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
NKJV.28: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
NKJV.29: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
NKJV.30: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim; Seled died without children.
NKJV.31: The son of Appaim was Ishi, the son of Ishi was Sheshan, and Sheshan’s son was Ahlai.
NKJV.32: The sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai, were Jether and Jonathan; Jether died without children.
NKJV.33: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
NKJV.34: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarha.
NKJV.35: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife, and she bore him Attai.
NKJV.36: Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad;
NKJV.37: Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed;
NKJV.38: Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah;
NKJV.39: Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah;
NKJV.40: Eleasah begot Sismai, and Sismai begot Shallum;
NKJV.41: Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.
NKJV.42: The descendants of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha, his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
NKJV.43: The sons of Hebron were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
NKJV.44: Shema begot Raham the father of Jorkoam, and Rekem begot Shammai.
NKJV.45: And the son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
NKJV.46: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.
NKJV.47: And the sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
NKJV.48: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
NKJV.49: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
NKJV.50: These were the descendants of Caleb: The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, were Shobal the father of Kirjath Jearim,
NKJV.51: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
NKJV.52: And Shobal the father of Kirjath Jearim had descendants: Haroeh, and half of the families of Manuhoth.
NKJV.53: The families of Kirjath Jearim were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. From these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
NKJV.54: The sons of Salma were Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half of the Manahethites, and the Zorites.
NKJV.55: And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Suchathites. These were the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

ESV.1: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
ESV.2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
ESV.3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah; these three Bath-shua the Canaanite bore to him. Now Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in the sight of the LORD, and he put him to death.
ESV.4: His daughter-in-law Tamar also bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
ESV.5: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
ESV.6: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara, five in all.
ESV.7: The son  of Carmi: Achan, the troubler of Israel, who broke faith in the matter of the devoted thing;
ESV.9: The sons of Hezron that were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
ESV.10: Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, prince of the sons of Judah.
ESV.11: Nahshon fathered Salmon,  Salmon fathered Boaz,
ESV.12: Boaz fathered Obed, Obed fathered Jesse.
ESV.13: Jesse fathered Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
ESV.14: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
ESV.15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.
ESV.16: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
ESV.17: Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
ESV.18: Caleb the son of Hezron fathered children by his wife Azubah, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
ESV.19: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
ESV.20: Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
ESV.21: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old, and she bore him Segub.
ESV.22: And Segub fathered Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
ESV.23: But Geshur and Aram took from them Havvoth-jair, Kenath, and its villages, sixty towns. All these were descendants of Machir, the father of Gilead.
ESV.24: After the death of Hezron, Caleb went in to Ephrathah,  the wife of Hezron his father, and she bore him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
ESV.25: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron: Ram, his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
ESV.26: Jerahmeel also had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
ESV.27: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
ESV.28: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
ESV.29: The name of Abishur's wife was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

MSG.20: Hur had Uri and Uri had Bezalel.
MSG.21: Some time later Hezron married the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead; he was sixty years old when he married her; she gave birth to Segub.
MSG.22: Then Segub had Jair who owned twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
MSG.23: Geshur and Aram captured the nomadic villages of Jair and Kenath and their satellite settlements—sixty towns. These all belonged to Makir the father of Gilead.
MSG.24: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrathah the wife of his father Hezron; she then gave birth to Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
MSG.25: The sons of Jerahmeel, Hezron's firstborn: Ram his firstborn, followed by Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
MSG.26: Jerahmeel had another wife whose name was Atarah; she gave birth to Onam.
MSG.27: The sons of Ram, Jerahmeel's firstborn: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
MSG.28: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
MSG.29: Abishur's wife was Abihail; she gave birth to Ahban and Molid.
MSG.30: Nadab had Seled and Appaim. Seled died leaving no sons.
MSG.31: Appaim had Ishi; Ishi had Sheshan; and Sheshan had Ahlai.
MSG.32: Jada, Shammai's brother, had Jether and Jonathan. Jether died leaving no sons.
MSG.33: Jonathan had Peleth and Zaza. This is the family tree of the sons of Jerahmeel.
MSG.34: Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. But Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, Jarha.
MSG.35: Sheshan married his daughter to Jarha and she gave birth to Attai.
MSG.36: Attai had Nathan, Nathan had Zabad,
MSG.37: Zabad had Ephlal, Ephlal had Obed,
MSG.38: Obed had Jehu, Jehu had Azariah,
MSG.39: Azariah had Helez, Helez had Eleasah,
MSG.40: Eleasah had Sismai, Sismai had Shallum,
MSG.41: Shallum had Jekamiah, and Jekamiah had Elishama.
MSG.42: Jerahmeel's brother Caleb had a son, his firstborn, named Mesha; Mesha had Ziph; Ziph's son was Mareshah the father of Hebron.
MSG.43: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
MSG.44: Shema had Raham the father of Jorkeam; Rekem had Shammai.
MSG.45: Shammai's son was Maon and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
MSG.46: Caleb's concubine Ephah gave birth to Haran, Moza, and Gazez; Haran had Gazez.
MSG.47: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
MSG.48: Another concubine of Caleb, Maacah, gave birth to Sheber and Tirhanah.
MSG.49: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah and Sheva the father of Macbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Acsah.
MSG.50: These made up the Caleb branch of the family tree. The sons of Hur, Ephrathah's firstborn: Shobal who had Kiriath Jearim,
MSG.51: Salma who had Bethlehem, and Hareph father of Beth Gader.
MSG.52: The family of Shobal, father of Kiriath Jearim: Haroeh, half of the population of Manahath,
MSG.53: the families of Kiriath Jearim, the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and Eshtaolites also came from this line.
MSG.54: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half of the Manahathites, the Zorites,
MSG.55: and the families of Sopherim who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. They made up the Kenites who came from Hammath the father of the house of Recab.
